# fray-relay-client

> Rust Nostr relay client with bounded verified reads, standing subscriptions, publish acknowledgements and NIP-42 authentication.

## Documentation

- [Rust integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray-relay-client/blob/main/README.md): Client API, relay health, request limits and the in-memory test relay.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray-relay-client): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
